Implement the smallest event-ledger design, preferably no SQLite schema migration:
- Add a durable content-free solution-shadow recommendation event/method distinct from routing shadow. Enroll only runs whose workflow/task class is feature or bugfix; noneligible classes must return not_enrolled without creating a recommendation event.
- Expose recording through the existing task_control tool as an action such as solution_shadow; do not add a public MCP tool. Keep smart-v3 exactly 8 tools.
- Recommendation contract: recommendation_id; policy/version solution_economics_shadow_v1; candidate solution scope (bounded paths/count/scope class); estimated touched surface with files/lines/symbols nullable; root-cause confidence as bounded ordinal unknown|low|medium|high plus provenance; oracle strength unknown|weak|strong plus provenance; expected repair risk unknown|low|medium|high plus provenance, never a fabricated probability; smallest causal solution recommendation as content-free structured target surface/change-kind/causal-fix-oracle/bounded-surface flags, no prompt/code/patch text. Missing data remains null/unknown.
- Bind the event to run_id/wave_id and durable source identity from the current wave (base_head/worktree_fp/contract_fp where present), record seq/event_time, and prove it is pre-mutation: reject recording if the current run/wave has already acquired a write lease or otherwise has a durable mutation-start event. Outcome projection should include recommendation_seq and first_write_seq and an explicit predates_mutation boolean/unknown.
- Idempotency must be strict: same recommendation_id + same normalized evidence returns recorded=false; same id with conflicting evidence fails closed.
- Add solution shadow outcome projection joining the recommendation to accepted_result_economics/accepted_result_evaluation and existing durable evidence. Include accepted, first_pass_accepted, repaired, replan_count, time_to_accepted/TTAR, proof records/duration, quality/manual_fix_required, files/lines/symbols touched only when durably observed, local execution and wait measurements only when already observed. Missing measurement must remain null/unknown, never 0 by default. Touched surface is explanatory only.
- Add aggregate P4 shadow report/readiness over feature+bugfix recommendations: enrollment/matched-outcome counts, predictor coverage, categorical outcome summaries sufficient to inspect associations, explicit observational/non-causal semantics, and gate_status collecting/hold until predictive usefulness is actually demonstrated. automatic_activation/policy_promotion must always be false in P4.

- Add focused tests covering feature+bugfix enrollment, non-enrollment, strict idempotency, unknown-not-zero, rejection after write starts, source identity/pre-mutation proof, first-pass and replanned accepted outcome joins, aggregate collection status/no activation, evaluation report inclusion, and smart-v3 8-tool contract/action schema if changed.
